$comment: Written by `pnpm compose:posts`. Do not edit by hand: re-run the script.
One model-written LinkedIn post per topic. Each is re-checked when the site is built;
a stale or failing post is dropped and its topic uses the built-in template.

black-giant.text:
EnergyX describes the Black Giant project at Salar de Punta Negra, Antofagasta, Chile across 100,000+ acres.

EnergyX publishes a planned capacity of 53Ktpa LCE† for the project.

The company states an in-situ resource estimate of 9.8M tonnes LCE†.

Source: EnergyX's public pages.

† Planned and estimated figures describe goals or projections. They may change, or may not happen. Each one links to the page it was taken from.

water.text:
Conventional lithium extraction uses up to 400,000 gallons per ton.

EnergyX publishes around 800 gallons per ton for its own process.

The company describes this difference as a freshwater reduction of over 90%.

Source: EnergyX's public pages.

dle.text:
Conventional lithium extraction uses up to 400,000 gallons per ton, while EnergyX states its process uses around 800 gallons per ton.

EnergyX publishes over 90% as the freshwater reduction of its process compared to conventional extraction.

The company describes a processing time of Days (also published as Hours).

Source: EnergyX's public pages.
